target_construction: simple average of the 60 one-second BRTI values in the minute before window OPEN (== floor_strike)
settlement_construction: simple average of the 60 one-second BRTI values in the minute before EXPIRY (== expiration_value)
note: each window's floor_strike == the prior window's expiration_value (open avg = prior close avg) -> pure up/down over the block
outcome_source: Kalshi official result (BRTI-based); our labels use this
